data.long_meaning: From Old English 'Gar-ric', 'spear rule' or 'spear power'. Possibly of Old Norse origin. The name Garrick carries the meaning “Spear rule” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garrick usually hope their child will grow to embody spear rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Γαρρίκ

in_latin.name: Garricus
